description.off: MCP lets AI agents such as Claude Code read the router state: service status, routes, connections, nodes, config versions, the log and diagnostics. Access is read-only: an agent cannot change anything.
description.on: An agent connects to the address below with the access token. The access is read-only.

off.status: MCP is off. No agent can connect.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the token?
regenerate.description: The old token stops working at once. Every agent that uses it has to be given the new one.

disable.title: Disable MCP?
disable.description: The address stops answering and the token stops working. Enabling MCP again issues a new token.

warning.title: The token is shown only once
warning.description: Copy it now. After you close this window it cannot be shown again; you can only regenerate it.

copy.failed: The browser did not allow copying: {{name}} is selected, press Ctrl+C
